text.card: A red giant 2,426 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.98 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,974 K at its surface.
